newsitem.title: UK: Ultra Electronics places stock at 250p.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Electronics places stock at 250p.

text.p: Shares in Ultra Electronics Plc were placed at 250p with institutional investors ahead of a stock market debut planned for October 3, sponsor to the issue Schroders said on Thursday.
"The placing has gone extremely well," said chief executive Julian Blogh. "It was oversubscribed two and a half times. The institutions received it very well."

Ultra, which designs and manufactures products for the defence and aerospace markets, will raise 85.9 million stg with the issue. Funds will be used to finance the redemption of preference shares and a management share buy-back.
Cazenove is broker to the placing, which is underwritten and sponsored by Schroders. At the placing price, Ultra is valued at 162.5 million stg.
